extractions.content: How can small models efficiently communicate their learned skills?
The communication mechanism should be scalable to accommodate a growing number of models.
The mechanism must preserve the integrity of models' learned skills during communication.
A centralized server or a blockchain-based system can be used to store and share model weights.
Models can periodically upload their weights to the centralized server and download the necessary weights to maintain their skills.
